description: Free, no sign-in, Pro or credits needed: 10 checks a minute and 100 a day per IP address (per account when signed in). Checks a public website live and returns its 0–100 AI search readiness score, grade, category scores, which AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks, whether llms.txt exists, and the top 3 fixes. Saves no report — audit_url (Pro) lists every failing check with a shareable report and badge.
